findings: R. W. Darwin, J. M. Herbert and Robert FitzRoy remain separate authorities.
No sent-date-only receipt claims are made. FitzRoy 135 is preserved as pre-departure context and is not promoted into a target edge.
Darwin 310 and FitzRoy 312 are a possible return-period pair but remain candidate-only pending explicit body acknowledgment.
limitations: No inline figure assets were present in the preserved HTML files.
The requested Beagle review instructions directory was absent; this follows the established Luna schema.
